item.title: [Telugu] [OTT Release] The Traitors Telugu
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTelugu
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date15 Oct 2026

The Traitors Telugu is the regional adaptation of the popular international reality series. Hosted by actor Teja Sajja, the show features 20 contestants who live together and compete in various challenges to build a prize pot. However, among them are secretly chosen 'Traitors' whose goal is to eliminate the 'Innocents' without getting caught. The Innocents must work together to uncover the Traitors

item.title: [Telugu] [OTT Release] Balu Geetha
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTelugu
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date15 Oct 2026

Balu Geetha follows the journey of two young people who meet while searching for their ideal life partners. Their encounter sparks a series of unexpected, funny, and emotional situations. As they navigate these experiences, their initial friendship deepens into something more significant, all while dealing with family emotions and the inherent challenges of relationships that put their bond to the test.

Kaagitham Padavalu is an upcoming Telugu movie scheduled to be released on 24 Jul, 2026. The movie is directed by MGR Thukaram and will feature Vardhan, Krishna Priya, MGR Thukaram and Keerthana Naresh as lead characters. It is described as a beautiful love story based on true events.
